component.name: MojitoShield
component.summary: Local security checks for Linux Mint

description.p: MojitoShield runs local, read-only checks of basic security settings and explains what each result means, what was checked and what could not be determined. It is guidance for everyday users, not a complete security audit.

ul.li: Checks the firewall, security updates, screen lock, automatic login, Timeshift snapshots, network services, AppArmor, disk encryption and boot menu protection
Works offline and never changes system settings
Asks for administrator permission only for an optional extended scan

description.p: System up to date now warns about security updates that have waited too long.
Boot menu protection checks disk encryption or an active GRUB password.
Nine revised checks and a better layout in wide windows.
